hooks.name: Brain capture
hooks.description: After each spec task, append durable learnings to this repo's decisions log.

action.prompt: Review the spec task that just finished. If it produced a durable learning (a decision and why, a convention to repeat, a gotcha to avoid, or a definition of a term or metric), append one line per learning under '## Entries' in .kiro/steering/decisions-log.md, using the format '- YYYY-MM-DD | type | note (because ...) | source' with the spec/task name as source. Most tasks produce nothing worth logging: if so, write nothing. Skip debugging play-by-play, anything already in code or comments, and anything still undecided. Append only: do not edit, reorder or delete existing lines, and do not touch any other file, especially global steering.
